This article compares the fulfillment of Indikator 1 across Danish regions and child and youth psychiatric facilities, tracking performance over multiple reporting periods [^src1] [^src2]. The indicator measures the proportion of specific examinations (noted as somatic examinations in the source summaries) completed according to clinical standards [^src2].

**Leaders and Trailers**
Performance varies drastically across facilities. In the most recent data, [[bua-psykiatrisk-klinik-for-skoleboern|BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Skolebørn]] leads with a 96% fulfillment rate [^src2], closely followed by [[bua-smaborn-klinik|BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn]] at 95% [^src2]. [[aabenna-borne-og-ungdomspsykiatrisk-ambulatorium|Aabenraa: Børne og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium]] and [[odense-borne-og-ungdomspsykiatrisk-ambulatorium|Odense: Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium]] also perform strongly at 91% and 90%, respectively [^src2]. Conversely, the lowest scores are found among private providers and specialized clinics: [[privathospitaler|Privathospitaler]], Hejmdal Privathospital, and Klinik for børn- og unge all report 0% fulfillment [^src2]. BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Unge also struggles, scoring just 9% in the latest period [^src2].

**Targets Met and Missed**
The tables include a strict "Standard opfyldt?" (Standard met?) flag. The vast majority of regions and facilities miss the target [^src1] [^src2]. At the regional level, none of the five Danish regions ([[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]], [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]], [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]]) meet the standard in either reporting period [^src1] [^src2]. However, at the facility level, Aabenraa and Odense consistently meet the standard across both reports [^src1] [^src2]. The later report shows that BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Skolebørn, BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn, and BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Spiseforstyrrelser also successfully meet the standard [^src2].

**Trends Across Reporting Periods**
Nationally, the fulfillment rate experienced a steady decline from 70% in 2021/22 to 61% in 2022/23, and further to 59% in the 2023/24 period as recorded in the first report [^src1]. A subsequent report shows a national figure of 65% for the latest period, suggesting either a data revision or a different calculation scope [^src2]. Regional trends are mixed: [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] saw a severe drop from 44% to 23% before rebounding sharply to 71% in the latest data [^src1] [^src2]. [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] declined from 60% to 49% [^src2]. At the facility level, [[bua-psykiatrisk-klinik-for-skoleboern|BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Skolebørn]] achieved a remarkable turnaround, jumping from 74% to 96% [^src2], while BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Udredning improved from 14% to 82% [^src2].

**Outliers**
[[privathospitaler|Privathospitaler]] and specific private branches like Hejmdal Privathospital stand out as outliers with 0% fulfillment despite having patients in the denominator [^src2]. Additionally, BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Spiseforstyrrelser reports a 100% fulfillment rate, but this is based on a heavily redacted or minimal patient count, making it a statistical outlier rather than a high-volume leader [^src2]. [[hillerod-psykiatrisk-ambulatorium-boern-og-unge|Hillerød: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge]] remains consistently high (80-81%) but still misses the formal standard target [^src1] [^src2].
